meta: When an app built by AI breaks, it's usually because the description was too vague. Three steps: say who uses it, walk through each step, and build one feature at a time.

muc.title: Vague descriptions break apps
muc.text: When an app built by AI breaks, it's usually not because AI is bad, but because the description was too vague.

muc.title: Say who uses it
muc.text: First, say clearly who will use the app. An app for a second grader is completely different from an app for an accountant.

muc.title: Walk through each step
muc.text: Next, describe each step the user takes: open the app, enter an amount, tap save, then see the month's total spending.

muc.title: One feature at a time
muc.text: Don't ask for everything at once. Get the main part working first, then add features one by one.

muc.title: Three lines of description
muc.text: Before asking AI, write three lines: who uses the app, what steps they take, and which buttons the first screen has.
